requiredFindings.title: installRootFilesystems does not already qualify ACL omission
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A measured profile row lists apfs and matches the observed boot, but the omission fixtures were not run for that kernel or a later kernel omits a stored ACL while keeping the same type name. InitialPlatform mints Evidence B from type-name membership. The creator treats an omitted ACL on / as an empty ACL.

scope: Text review of proposal 458 and the creator-plan order. No native job was run.
